title: A row loaded from an answer at 101 keeps it when a late answer at 100 arrives, with no live message in between
why: The guard is the row's delivered position, not a live message: an answer older than the one the row came from (a list read that left before a later one, answered after it) changes nothing, so the row keeps the 101 answer's latestActivitySeq (which orders and previews the row) and its unread.
